[biotechnology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/biotechnology/biotechnology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use evidence of life processes and origin to classify an object and justify the decision through diagnostic features. [ecosystemsAndBiodiversity.data.ts](../../../learningApps/biology/data/skills/ecology/ecosystemsAndBiodiversity/ecosystemsAndBiodiversity.data.ts)
